sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS FOR THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... A STRONG UPPER TROUGH WILL DIG SEWD ACROSS THE GREAT BASIN TOWARD THE FOUR CORNERS REGION DURING THE FORECAST PERIOD. AS THIS OCCURS...MIDLEVEL RIDGING WILL OCCUR OVER THE GREAT PLAINS...WHILE A LOW AMPLITUDE UPPER IMPULSE MOVES ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES DURING THE AFTERNOON BEFORE REACHING NEW ENGLAND TUE MORNING. AT THE SURFACE...THE PRESSURE PATTERN WILL BE SOMEWHAT DISORGANIZED DURING MON MORNING IN THE WAKE OF THE GREAT LAKES IMPULSE. HOWEVER...HEIGHT FALLS OVER THE SRN ROCKIES AND ADJACENT CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL LEAD TO RAPID CYCLOGENESIS OVER ERN CO DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH SUBSEQUENT STRENGTHENING OF A BROAD LOW-LEVEL SLY JET OVER THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS. E OF THE DEEPENING LOW...A STATIONARY FRONT WILL EXTEND ACROSS NEB TOWARD THE LOWER GREAT LAKES...WHILE A DRYLINE SHARPENS FROM E-CNTRL CO INTO NWRN TX. DURING THE OVERNIGHT...THE SURFACE LOW IS FORECAST TO ADVANCE EWD INTO KS...WITH THE FRONT MOVING SWD ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: STRENGTHENING SLY FLOW OVER THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS WILL ESTABLISH LOW TO MID 60S DEWPOINTS FROM TX NWD TOWARD SRN KS DURING THE AFTERNOON...WITH 50S DEWPOINTS ADVANCING INTO NRN KS...SRN NEB...AND IA. OVER ERN CO...NWRN KS...AND SWRN NEB...LOW-LEVEL WINDS WILL BACK STRONGLY OUT OF THE ESE AS THE SURFACE LOW DEEPENS...WHICH WILL BRING 40S TO LOW 50S DEWPOINTS INTO THE AREA BY LATE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. DESPITE THE MOISTENING BOUNDARY LAYER...A STRONG EML WILL BE PRESENT ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR...WHICH WILL INHIBIT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT DURING THE MORNING INTO PART OF THE AFTERNOON. INITIAL SURFACE BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE MOST PROBABLE OVER ERN CO/WRN KS AND SWRN NEB AS STRONG LARGE-SCALE ASCENT SPREADS ACROSS A DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER. COMBINATION OF SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 70S...AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES FROM 500-1500 J/KG. LOW-LEVEL RESPONSE TO THE APPROACHING UPPER TROUGH WILL FAVOR LONG HODOGRAPHS IN THE 0-3 KM LAYER...RESULTING IN STRONG STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW AND LARGE SRH FOR SUPERCELLS POSING A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND TORNADOES. AFTER DARK...STORMS OVER THE HIGH PLAINS WILL ADVANCE/D

sections.title: SRN LAKE MI AREA AND SRN LOWER MI...UPPER OH VALLEY...WRN NY
sections.text: AN UPPER IMPULSE AND ASSOCIATED 40-50 KT DEEP-LAYER WLY FLOW IS FORECAST TO ADVANCE FROM SRN LAKE MI/LOWER MI AND THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO WRN NY DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MODEST DESTABILIZATION WILL OCCUR OVER THE AREA AS THIS TAKES PLACE...WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW/MID 50S AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES FROM 500-1000 J/KG. THIS ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT A LOW-END THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL. ..GARNER/BROYLES.. 04/08/2013

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... STRONG NNWLY MID-UPPER LEVEL WINDS /100-125 KT PER 12Z OAKLAND CA SOUNDING/ WILL SUPPORT FURTHER DIGGING/AMPLIFICATION OF A TROUGH ACROSS THE GREAT BASIN/LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY TO THE FOUR CORNERS REGION BY 12Z TUE. WEAK TO NEUTRAL HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED DOWNSTREAM OF THIS TROUGH ACROSS THE PLAINS TODAY...WITH HEIGHT FALLS NOT EXPECTED TO REACH THE CENTRAL/SRN HIGH PLAINS UNTIL AFTER 09/00Z. LEE CYCLOGENESIS IS EXPECTED OVER ERN CO BY AFTERNOON WITH A BROAD LLJ DEVELOPING FROM TX THROUGH OK TO KS THIS EVENING. A WARM FRONT WILL MOVE NWD FROM KS INTO NEB...AND SHOULD MERGE WITH AND BE OVERTAKEN BY A SWD MOVING COLD FRONT EARLY THIS EVENING IN NEB. MEANWHILE...A COMPACT...PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW MOVING INTO NRN IL AT THE START OF DAY 1 PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND SURFACE ANALYSIS WILL TRACK ENEWD THROUGH LOWER MI THIS AFTERNOON AND SHOULD REACH NRN NY BY 12Z TUE. AHEAD OF THESE FEATURES...A WARM FRONT WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE NWD INTO SRN LOWER MI...TOWARD THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND EVENTUALLY SPREAD ACROSS NY.

sections.title: CENTRAL AND SRN PLAINS
sections.text: A STRONG CAP EVIDENT THIS MORNING PER 12Z SOUNDINGS AT NORMAN OK/FORT WORTH TX COMBINED WITH EXPECTED WARMING IN THE MIDLEVELS DOWNSTREAM OF THE DIGGING WRN TROUGH REMAIN SUBSTANTIAL LIMITING FACTORS FOR AFTERNOON DEEP CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT. THESE CONCERNS COMBINED WITH CONVECTIVE ALLOWING MODELS /00Z 4 KM WRF-NMM/NSSL AND 09Z HRRR/ NOT PRODUCING A SIGNAL FOR TSTMS FROM NWRN TX...WRN OK INTO MUCH OF KS PRIOR TO 09/00Z HAS WARRANTED REDUCING SEVERE PROBABILITIES OVER NWRN TX AND WRN OK. OTHERWISE...CURRENT THINKING SUGGESTS THE REMAINDER OF THE FORECAST FOR ERN CO...WRN-NRN KS...SRN NEB TO FAR SWRN IA REMAINS THE SAME FROM THE 06Z ISSUANCE OF THE DAY1 OUTLOOK. INITIAL SURFACE BASED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT APPEARS TO BE MOST LIKELY OVER ERN CO/WRN KS AND SWRN NEB AS INCREASING LARGE-SCALE ASCENT SPREADS ACROSS A DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER. COMBINATION OF SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...SURFACE HEATING...AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES FROM 500-1500 J/KG. LOW-LEVEL RESPONSE TO THE APPROACHING UPPER TROUGH WILL FAVOR LONG HODOGRAPHS IN THE 0-3 KM LAYER...RESULTING IN STRONG STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW AND LARGE SRH FOR SUPERCELLS POSING A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL

sections.title: PART OF THE MIDWEST TO NWRN PA/WRN NY
sections.text: NO CHANGE IS NEEDED WITH THIS PORTION OF THE OUTLOOK AS LOW SEVERE WIND AND HAIL PROBABILITIES WILL BE MAINTAINED. FORCING FOR ASCENT ALONG THE TRACK OF THE PROGRESSIVE NRN IL SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF A 40-60 KT WLY MIDLEVEL JET SHOULD PROVE FAVORABLE IN SUPPORTING TSTM DEVELOPMENT THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING... MAINLY INVOF THE WARM FRONT. SSWLY LOW LEVEL WINDS ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR WILL CONTINUE TO ADVECT MOISTURE /SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S/ INTO THIS REGION. THIS COMBINED WITH SOME SURFACE HEATING BENEATH A PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES SPREADING EWD THROUGH THE OH VALLEY AND SRN GREAT LAKES SHOULD RESULT IN MLCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG. THIS ENVIRONMENT MAY SUPPORT A LOW-END THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: FOUR CORNERS REGION
sections.text: STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT WAS EVIDENT PRIOR TO 12Z TODAY WITH THE DIGGING CA SHORTWAVE TROUGH AS A TSTM OCCURRED OVER ERN NV. THE EXIT REGION OF THE ACCOMPANYING MID-UPPER LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO REACH THE FOUR CORNERS REGION THIS AFTERNOON AND SHOULD SUPPORT HIGH BASED CONVECTION WITHIN A STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ENVIRONMENT. MEAGER INSTABILITY /A FEW HUNDRED J PER KG/ SHOULD LIMIT THE COVERAGE OF STRONGER ACTIVITY...BUT 30-40 DEGREE DEWPOINT DEPRESSIONS SUGGEST STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THUS...THIS OUTLOOK INCLUDES A LOW SEVERE WIND PROBABILITY FOR PART OF THE FOUR CORNERS. ..PETERS/ROGERS.. 04/08/2013

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: AN INTENSE MIDLEVEL TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 110-120 KT JET STREAK WILL CONTINUE TO DIG ESEWD OVER AZ/NM THROUGH TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...LEE CYCLOGENESIS IS EXPECTED ACROSS SE CO...WITH A SHARPENING DRYLINE ARCING TO THE SE NEAR THE WRN OK BORDER...AND THE SURFACE WARM SECTOR WILL BE ESTABLISHED ACROSS THE CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS TO THE MS RIVER. MEANWHILE...A SURGE OF CONTINENTAL POLAR AIR WILL SPREAD SWD ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS...REINFORCING A STRONG FRONT FROM NE CO INTO NEB BY TONIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS HAVE SLOWLY INCREASED THE PAST TWO DAYS TO THE MID-UPPER 60S ACROSS S TX...WITH LOW 60S AS FAR N AS OK AND MID-UPPER 50S ACROSS THE SE THREE QUARTERS OF KS. MEANWHILE...A RELATIVELY WARM EML...SAMPLED BY THE 12Z SOUNDINGS ACROSS OK/TX...WILL SPREAD NEWD OVER KS AS MIDLEVEL FLOW GRADUALLY BACKS IN ADVANCE OF THE DEEP TROUGH TO THE W. WITH ONLY LOW-LEVEL ASCENT EXPECTED IN A NARROW ZONE ALONG THE DRYLINE THIS AFTERNOON...AND SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTIVE INHIBITION LIKELY TO PERSIST OVER MUCH OF THE KS/OK/TX WARM SECTOR...CONVECTIVE INITIATION APPEARS UNLIKELY. OF THE FEW MODEL FORECASTS THAT DO SHOW CONVECTIVE PRECIPITATION OR EXPLICIT STORMS...THE MEAN BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS AS HIGH AS 66 F LOOK TO BE TOO HIGH COMPARED TO REGIONAL OBSERVATIONS. IF A STORM FORMS...THE ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR AT LEAST LARGE HAIL...BUT THIS RISK REMAINS HIGHLY CONDITIONAL. THE MORE PROBABLE AREA FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING WILL BE ACROSS ERN CO ON THE NW EDGE OF THE RICHER LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE...AND NW OF THE STRONGER CAP. THE INITIAL HIGH-BASED CONVECTION WILL LIKELY FORM IN THE DEEPLY MIXED ENVIRONMENT ACROSS ERN CO BY ABOUT

sections.title: AZ RIM COUNTRY TO FOUR CORNERS THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A STRONG BAND OF ASCENT IN THE LEFT EXIT REGION OF THE MID-UPPER JET...AND AN ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT...WILL CROSS NRN AZ AND THE FOUR CORNERS REGION THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON. THOUGH MOISTURE IS SOMEWHAT LIMITED...THE STRONG ASCENT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT A BAND OF CONVECTION ACROSS THIS AREA. THE STEEP LAPSE RATES AND STRONG DEEP-LAYER SWLY FLOW WILL SUPPORT A RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG/DAMAGING GUSTS.

sections.title: INDIANA TO OH/NW PA/WRN NY THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: A PRONOUNCED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS MOVING ENEWD OVER NRN INDIANA/SW LOWER MI...AND WILL CONTINUE OVER THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TONIGHT WITH AN ACCOMPANYING SURFACE CYCLONE. THE PRIMARY LIMITING FACTOR FOR DEEP CONVECTION AND ANY SEVERE THREAT WILL BE THE QUALITY OF THE LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. 15Z OBSERVATIONS SHOW PRIMARILY UPPER 40S DEW POINTS ACROSS OH...AS OPPOSED TO LOWER 50S SHOWN IN THE 12Z NAM FORECASTS FOR THE SAME TIME. THE PHASING OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WITH THE ZONE OF ASCENT IS ALREADY POOR...AND ANY DELAY IN LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING WILL FURTHER LIMIT WHAT IS ALREADY EXPECTED TO BE MINIMAL BUOYANCY. WILL MAINTAIN LOW WIND PROBABILITIES INTO PART OF THIS AREA...BUT THE WIND DAMAGE RISK IS MARGINAL AT BEST. ..THOMPSON/MOSIER.. 04/08/2013

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS CENTRAL PLAINS
CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: COMPLEX SFC MAP WAS ANALYZED AT 19Z WITH MAIN SFC LOW STILL BACK OVER CO MTNS...WARM FRONT ENEWD ACROSS NERN CO TO S-CENTRAL NEB...AND ARCTIC COLD FRONT SURGING SWD ACROSS S-CENTRAL/SERN WY AND NWRN PORTIONS NEB PANHANDLE. PERSISTENT BUT NOW ERODING LOW CLOUD COVER HAS LEFT DIFFERENTIAL-HEATING BOUNDARY ARCHING FROM WARM-FRONTAL INTERSECTION OVER S-CENTRAL NEB...SWWD ACROSS NWRN KS BETWEEN HLC-GLD...THEN SWD OVER WRN KS AND ERN OK PANHANDLE...THEN EWD ACROSS NRN OK. THIS BOUNDARY WILL BECOME MORE DIFFUSE WITH TIME...BUT RESIDUAL THERMAL AXIS SHOULD PERSIST ACROSS ERN CO AND NWRN KS AS MOIST ADVECTION INCREASES BOUNDARY-LAYER PW FROM SE. MEANWHILE DRYLINE OVER OK PANHANDLE AND NRN TX PANHANDLE HAS BEEN SHUNTED WWD BY EFFECTS OF LACK OF HEATING/MIXING RELATED TO EARLIER CLOUD COVER. CLEARING/HEATING IN THIS AREA SHOULD SMOOTH DRYLINE CURVATURE FROM SWRN KS SEWD ACROSS SWRN OK AND NW TX THROUGH 23Z. DRYLINE THEREAFTER SHOULD RETREAT ACROSS W TX AND TX PANHANDLE. CONVECTIVE POTENTIAL ALONG DRYLINE FROM RED RIVER TO SWRN KS APPEARS VERY CONDITIONAL...AND TOO SMALL TO CONTINUE UNCONDITIONAL PROBABILITIES FROM RED RIVER SWD. ISOLATED CELL HAS FORMED NW AKO...AND VIS STLT IMAGERY INDICATES

sections.title: LA
sections.text: GEN TSTM AREA ADDED IN DEFERENCE TO CONVECTION...INCLUDING ISOLATED TO WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS. ACTIVITY IS OCCURRING IN ELEVATED LOW-LEVEL WAA ZONE THAT APPEARS TO EXTEND SWD ACROSS NWRN GULF...IN ADVANCE OF WEAK/NEWD MOVING SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER S TX AND EXTREME NERN MEX. BUOYANCY SHOULD REMAIN WEAK...WITH ACTIVITY BELOW SVR LIMITS. ..EDWARDS.. 04/08/2013 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1124 AM CDT MON APR 08 2013/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTM ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST THROUGHOUT THE DAY...WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR A FEW STRONG GUSTS. OVERALL WEAK/TRANSIENT NATURE OF THE CONVECTION PRECLUDES THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN INTENSE MIDLEVEL TROUGH...AND ASSOCIATED STRONG MID/UPPER LEVEL WINDS...WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE SEWD ACROSS SRN NV AND INTO NRN AZ. AS IT DOES...A SURFACE LOW...CENTERED OVER SW NV AT 17Z...AND ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL ALSO MOVE EWD. STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT OVER THE LEFT EXIT OF THE MID/UPPER LEVEL JET STREAK IN CONJUNCTION WITH FORCING FROM THE COLD FRONT WILL SUPPORT CONTINUED TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS N-CNTRL/NERN AZ AND S-CNTRL/SWRN NV THROUGHOUT THE DAY. SCANT MOISTURE AND WEAK INSTABILITY /MUCAPE FROM 200-400 J PER KG/ WILL LIMIT UPDRAFT STRENGTH AND PERSISTENCE...BUT GIVEN THE STRONG FORCING AND ROBUST DEEP-LAYER WIND FIELD...A FEW STRONG...CONVECTIVELY-DRIVEN WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE. LIMITED STORM STRENGTH AND PERSISTENCE WILL PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM OVER FAR ERN CO ...AND MAY MATURE AND MOVE INTO WRN KS AND SWRN NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: PRESSURE FALLS CONTINUE AT AROUND 1.0 - 1.2 MB/HR ACROSS ERN CO AS TEMPERATURES CONTINUE TO RISE AND LOW LEVEL MOISTURE ATTEMPTS TO RETURN NWWD. THE SURFACE THETA-E AXIS WAS LOCATED FROM WRN OK INTO SERN CO JUST S OF A RELATIVELY COOL STRATUS-INDUCED COLD POCKET FROM GCK TO DDC. GRADUAL HEATING SHOULD CONTINUE ACROSS THE REGION...AND DESPITE LOWER DEWPOINTS IN THE 30S AND 40S OVER ERN CO...INSTABILITY WILL STILL BE PRESENT. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS AREAS OF CU BENEATH BROKEN CIRRUS NEAR LHX AND EXTENDING NWD TOWARD AKO. ALTHOUGH CONVERGENCE IS WEAK...A FEW UPDRAFTS SHOULD GROW INTO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL. WHEN THIS OCCURS...THE BACKED SELY LOW LEVEL WINDS SHOULD ALLOW CELLS TO TURN EWD AND MOVE ACROSS THE KS BORDER. HODOGRAPHS WILL BE QUITE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS...WITH MAXIMUM HAIL SIZE ESSENTIALLY LIMITED BY AVAILABLE MOISTURE. IF STORMS CAN PERSIST INTO THE 50 F DEWPOINT AIR...VERY LARGE HAIL WOULD BE LIKELY. A MARGINAL TORNADO THREAT COULD ALSO MATERIALIZE BUT ONLY IF CELLS CAN MAINTAIN STRENGTH INTO THE LOWER LCL ENVIRONMENT BEFORE CAPPING DESTROYS THEM.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS FORECAST TO OCCUR ALONG A SW-NE ORIENTED FRONTAL BOUNDARY OVER WRN/CNTRL NEB THIS EVENING. OTHER STORMS MAY MOVE NEWD OUT OF NERN CO INTO SWRN NEB...WHILE ISOLATED STORM DEVELOPMENT AHEAD OF THE FRONT IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION OVER PORTIONS OF S-CNTRL NEB AND FAR NRN KS. LARGE HAIL IS CURRENTLY EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREAT...THOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO AND DAMAGING WIND GUST WILL BE POSSIBLE AS WELL. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 2230Z...A FRONTAL BOUNDARY WAS POSITIONED FROM FAR NERN CO NEWD INTO CNTRL NEB. AS SURFACE LOW PRESSURE DEEPENS OVER SERN CO...THIS BOUNDARY WILL EVENTUALLY ADVANCE SWD ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. MEANWHILE...A 40+ KT LOW-LEVEL SLY JET IS FORECAST TO DEVELOP AFTER DARK...WHICH WILL AID IN STRONG CONVERGENCE INVOF THE FRONT. MID 50S DEWPOINTS HAVE BECOME ESTABLISHED ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT OVER SRN NEB. THIS MOISTURE COMBINED WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND TEMPERATURES MAINLY IN THE 60S IS AIDING IN MUCAPE VALUES FROM 500 J/KG ALONG THE FRONT TO VALUES AOA 1500 J/KG OVER FAR SRN NEB. THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE FRONT...WITH STRONGLY VEERING WIND PROFILES SUPPORTING A THREAT FOR SUPERCELLS AND LARGE HAIL. ISOLATED STORMS MAY MOVE OUT OF NERN CO INTO SWRN NEB AS WELL...AND THESE STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL...IN ADDITION TO ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO. OVER S-CNTRL NEB...A CELL RECENTLY ATTEMPTED TO DEVELOP IN NUCKOLLS COUNTY...WITH ADDITIONAL CLUMPING CU OVER FAR NRN KS. THE LACK OF A LOW-LEVEL FOCUS FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY PRECLUDE ROBUST THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IN THE SHORT-TERM. HOWEVER...IF CELLS DO MANAGE TO FORM AHEAD OF THE FRONT WITHIN THE EXIT REGION OF THE LLJ...THE ENVIRONMENT WOULD BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS POSING A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED INTENSE STORMS CONTINUE OVER NORTHEAST CO...AND MAY SPREAD EASTWARD INTO KS/NEB SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR/SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOW TWO SUPERCELL THUNDERSTORMS AFFECTING NORTHEAST CO. ONE OVER KIT CARSON COUNTY AND ONE OVER WASHINGTON COUNTY CO. THE SOUTHERN STORM HAS PRODUCED 1 INCH HAIL IN THE PAST 30 MIN. THE ACTIVITY IS MOVING NORTHEASTWARD INTO A PROGRESSIVELY MORE MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS AS SOUTHEAST LOW LEVEL WINDS TRANSPORT 50S DEWPOINTS INTO AREA. MESOSCALE MODEL SOLUTIONS CONTINUE TO SUGGEST THE POSSIBILITY THAT ONE OR TWO INTENSE STORMS COULD PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS AND EVENTUALLY TRACK INTO NEB. REFERENCE MCD NUMBER 402 FOR FURTHER DETAILS ON THIS THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING OVER CNTRL IND WILL SPREAD EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN/CNTRL OH THIS EVENING. ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE...BUT A WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST WV IMAGERY SHOWS AN UPPER IMPULSE MOVING EWD ACROSS THE GREAT LAKES REGION...WITH ASSOCIATED 50 KT MIDLEVEL WLY JET SPREADING ACROSS IND/OH. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE IS IN THE PROCESS OF EXITING LOWER MI...WITH A FRONTAL BOUNDARY TRAILING SWWD ACROSS NRN IND INTO IL. LOW 50S DEWPOINTS ARE SPREADING NEWD AHEAD OF THE FRONT ACROSS IND AND OH...WHICH IS AIDING IN MLCAPE VALUES UP TO 500 J/KG. CLUSTERS OF STORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED WITHIN THIS ENVIRONMENT OVER CNTRL IND...AND WILL SPREAD EWD ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN/CNTRL OH INTO EARLY NIGHT. GIVEN 40-50 KT DEEP-LAYER WLY FLOW OVER THE AREA /PER CLE VWP/...A FEW STRONG TO POSSIBLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY OCCUR WITH ANY SEMI-ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTER OR SMALL LINE SEGMENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CONTINUE ACROSS THE WATCH AREA. LARGE HAIL IS THE MAIN THREAT...BUT ISOLATED TORNADOES HAVE BEEN REPORTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUE ACROSS NORTHEAST CO AND SOUTHWEST KS. A POWERFUL COLD FRONT IS SURGING SOUTHWARD INTO THE AREA...NOW EXTENDING FROM DOUGLAS COUNTY NORTHEASTWARD INTO WASHINGTON COUNTY...WHERE IT INTERSECTS ONE OF THE MORE INTENSE STORMS. NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED BEHIND THE FRONT TO THE EAST OF DENVER. THESE STORMS ARE ELEVATED AND SHOULD PRIMARILY POSE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. FARTHER EAST...SUPERCELLS ARE AFFECTING PARTS OF WASHINGTON COUNTY CO /IMMEDIATELY ALONG THE COLD FRONT/...PHILLIPS COUNTY CO...AND CHEYENNE COUNTY KS. SOUTHEASTERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS CONTINUE TO RAPIDLY TRANSPORT 50S DEWPOINTS WESTWARD INTO THE REGION...HELPING TO DESTABILIZE THE AIR MASS AND CONTRIBUTE TO STRONG UPDRAFTS. LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREAT WITH THESE STORMS...BUT LOW LEVEL VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL CONTINUE TO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW TORNADOES THROUGH 03Z. A COOLING BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD STRENGTHEN THE CAP BY LATE EVENING...LESSENING THE TORNADO THREAT. mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS ARE OCCURRING ALONG AN AXIS FROM NORTHEAST CO...THROUGH SOUTHWEST AND CENTRAL NEB...TO NORTH OF OMA. ALMOST ALL OF THESE STORMS ARE NOW NORTH OF A SAGGING COLD FRONT...SEPARATING MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR TO THE SOUTH...AND RAPIDLY COOLING SURFACE TEMPERATURES TO THE NORTH. DESPITE THE CONTINUED SUPERCELL STORM STRUCTURES...THE ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO MOVE INTO THE PROGRESSIVELY DEEPER COLD AIRMASS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY THREAT. ONE EXCEPTION WOULD BE THE STORM IN HITCHCOCK COUNTY NEB. THIS STORM IS VERY NEAR THE SURFACE BOUNDARY AND HAS A HISTORY OF VERY STRONG LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION SIGNATURES. HOWEVER...EVEN THIS STORM WILL LIKELY BE UNDERCUT BY THE FRONT WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR. DUE TO THE MARGINAL NATURE OF THE HAIL THREAT...A WATCH IS UNLIKELY AT THIS TIME. ONE SCENARIO THAT MIGHT REQUIRE ACTION WOULD BE IF STORMS COULD BEGIN TO FORWARD-PROPAGATE AND TRACK ALONG THE BOUNDARY ACROSS SOUTHERN NEB.
